test.name: retrieval_event_logging
test.description: Verify retrieval event recording infrastructure for contrastive training data collection

metadata.author: reh3376
metadata.notes: Retrieval events are written to retrieval_events hypertable via RetrievalEventWriter. Captures every Retrieve() pipeline with pre/post rerank scores. The gap between vector recall scores and rerank scores is the hard-negative mining signal for contrastive embedding training.
